email.subject: Super Special Secret Tester Mission
email.body:
Yo,
Thanks for helping test! This is a warmup mission designed to get you re-familiarised with the hacking mechanics. You've been given a bunch of admin nodes to use, and your basic set of 4 programs (SSHCrack, WebServerWorm, SMTPOVerflow, FTPBounce).
Get Admin on the linked computer and reply to this to continue. Doing so will send you straight up to CSEC level where you can start accepting the newer contracts. Dont forget to go to the CSEC asset server first!
-Matt
.
